join.heading: Get a ring when your order is ready
join.intro: Enter the order number printed on your receipt.
join.soundHint: Your phone will ring from this page. Keep it open with the sound on.
join.waitingForCashierTitle: Waiting for the cashier to enter your number
join.waitingForCashierBody: Order {{number}} is not on the list yet. Stay on this page: we keep checking.
join.notYetBody: Check the number on your receipt, or ask at the counter.
join.invalidNumber: Use the letters and digits printed on your receipt.
join.venueBusy: This venue has too many open orders right now. Please ask at the counter.
join.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
join.failed: We couldn't reach the pager. Check your connection and try again.
join.venueNotFoundDescription: The link may be wrong, or the venue has switched its pager off. Please ask at the counter.

ticket.keepOpen: Keep this page open with the sound on. Your phone will ring when the order is ready.
ticket.alertMeHint: Sound is off on this page. Tap the button so your phone can ring.
ticket.acknowledged: Thanks. The counter knows you're on your way.
ticket.acknowledgeFailed: We couldn't tell the counter. Try again.
ticket.expiredHint: Ask at the counter if you are still waiting.
ticket.notFoundDescription: This link is no longer valid. Scan the code at the counter again.

board.heading: Pager
board.subheading: Enter the order number, then mark it ready to ring the customer's phone.
board.phoneLinked: A phone is following this order
board.enabledHint: Customers can open your pager link and follow their order.
board.strictHint: Customers can follow an order only after your staff have entered its number.
board.settingsAdminOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
board.disabledNotice: The pager is off. Customers can't join until you switch it on.
board.noAccess: You don't have access to the pager.
board.invalidNumber: Use letters and digits only, up to 12.
board.invalidTransition: This order has already moved on.
board.tooManyOpen: Too many open orders. Mark some as collected first.
